name: Suppressors Enhanced
description: An independent Story Mode suppressor simulation with recommended ALLIN1 integration and an optional launcher-free build.

systems.name: Suppressors Enhanced
systems.description: Witness-aware stealth plus weapon-specific suppressor heat, gradual center-out glow, critical smoke, wear, spark-pop failure, and replacement behavior.

settings.label: Realistic suppressor stealth
settings.description: Suppressors reduce actionable gunshot noise without hiding close, visible, alerted, impact-adjacent, or sustained fire.

settings.label: Suppressor wear and breakage
settings.description: Rapid overheating damages suppressors until they fail with a cosmetic spark and metallic pop, then must be replaced. Disable this to retain heat, glow, and smoke without permanent condition loss.

settings.label: Suppressor durability multiplier
settings.description: Scales suppressor life when breakage is enabled.

settings.label: Suppressor heat smoke
settings.description: Adds can-attached barrel smoke with a pronounced density boost near critical suppressor temperature.

settings.label: Heat smoke intensity
settings.description: Scales the size and density of suppressor heat-smoke trails.

settings.label: Temperature debug
settings.description: Shows the equipped suppressor's live can temperature as a small HUD readout.
